==Dialogue==
:''"Eh? Yes, I've heard all about the fighting. [[Elona]] seems to be in flames. No, no, I'm too old for all this nonsense. Leave an old man to his retirement."''

'''During [[A Sound of Ancient Horns]]:'''

:''"Ahmtur is still alive? Well, deep-fry me and throw me to the heket! And a prince now, of all things? He served under me back in the day, a long time ago. Yes, of course I'll help! This old war horse still knows a thing or two. And I know of more than a few others who would come running if [[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty|Ahmtur the Mighty]] calls. I will send my support to him at once."''
